svg.title: 1×2 fiber splitter — compact optical symbol
svg.desc: Editable, annotation-free functional symbol for a nominal 50:50 fiber splitter. One centered input on the left feeds two symmetric outputs on the right. The unboxed branching motif represents power division, not the physical core geometry of a fused-fiber coupler. Each output ideally receives half the input power; relative output phase, excess loss, bandwidth and polarization behavior are not specified by this icon. All three external fiber leads are short. Continuous pale gray cladding surrounds the blue cores through the leads and branching section, with no outer outlines, matching the component library. Colors and dimensions are schematic. All artwork is native editable SVG on a transparent background. Fiber connections and splitting motif are separate Inkscape layers.
